taper.formula_choice: Speed 30 mph < 45 mph threshold -> using L = W x S^2 / 60
taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-4 (taper length L). Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
taper.cdot_reference: CDOT S-630-1 Case 11 (right-shoulder closure, mirrored to the left shoulder of a one-way street)

buffer.lookup_text: MUTCD Table 6B-2: 200 ft (CDOT supplement silent at this speed)
buffer.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.06, Table 6B-2 (stopping sight distance)

spacing.in_taper_text: 30 mph -> 30 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals speed in feet)
spacing.on_tangent_text: 30 mph -> 60 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals 2x speed in feet)
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 40 ft / 30 ft max spacing -> 4 drums at 13.3 ft intervals
spacing.tangent_count_text: 1500 ft / 60 ft max spacing -> 26 cones at 60.0 ft intervals
spacing.buffer_count_text: Buffer: 200 ft / 60 ft max spacing -> 3 cones at 50.0 ft intervals (CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 2 General Note 18b: tangents along the buffer space)
spacing.downstream_count_text: Downstream taper: 50 ft at ~25 ft spacing -> 2 cones (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft downstream taper); 26 tangent + 3 buffer + 2 downstream = 31 cones total

case.case: Case 11: Shoulder closure on one-way street
case.narrative: This scenario follows CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1, Case 11, the general shoulder-work typical (drawn for freeway/expressway), applied to a one-way street with signs on the closed shoulder's side only, under CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 2 General Note 8's single-shoulder exception and MUTCD 11th Ed. Fig. 6P-3 Note 1 (p. 864).
case.narrative_2: The generated plan follows the same device layout as the reference case with spacing computed for 30 mph.

flagger.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Chapter 6D (Flagger Control) and Chapter 6E (One-Lane, Two-Way Traffic Control).

site_adjustments.action: Moved 3 advance warning sign(s) 140 ft farther upstream. The nearest sign now sits 240 ft from the taper (8 × 30 mph, the top of MUTCD §6B.04's urban range) instead of Table 6B-1's 100 ft, and the signs behind it keep Table 6B-1's spacing. The Engineer sets the final sign locations (CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 2 Note 10). Add advance warning signs where the line of sight to them is obstructed (Note 25).
site_adjustments.rule: MUTCD §6B.04: limited sight distance puts the nearest warning sign at the top of ¶04's urban or ¶06's rural range (p. 771)

site_adjustments.action: No devices added: the cross-street approach layout isn't generated. See the pending-verification disclosure.
site_adjustments.rule: MUTCD §6N.12 p. 848: Work within the Traveled Way at an Intersection (11th Ed.)

site_adjustments.action: Added 2 Type III barricades (sidewalk closure points) and 2 R9-9 SIDEWALK CLOSED signs at the upstream and downstream ends of the work zone.
site_adjustments.rule: MUTCD §6C.02: pedestrian considerations in work zones

details: Road curvature analysis not implemented; assume straight.

pending_verification.note: On a one-way street the plan builds an 8 ft shoulder and fits lanes under a 52 ft half-road less that shoulder. Both values are CHOSEN: no MUTCD, S-630-1, Colorado Supplement or Denver text found sets them. Verify against the site (#308).

items.label: On a one-way street the plan builds an 8 ft shoulder and fits lanes under a 52 ft half-road less that shoulder. Both values are CHOSEN: no MUTCD, S-630-1, Colorado Supplement or Denver text found sets them. Verify against the site (#308).

S-630-1 draws Case 11 for the right shoulder only. This plan mirrors it to the left shoulder of a one-way street: the same devices and distances, the LEFT SHOULDER CLOSED sign (MUTCD 11th Ed. §6H.22 ¶02, p. 807) and signs on the closed shoulder's side (Fig. 6P-3 Note 1, p. 864). The mirror is CHOSEN. Verify against the site (#300).

An adjacent intersection is flagged, but Conestruct does not generate the cross-street approach layout or evaluate traffic-signal operation, and adds no devices for it. Cross-street control design and the signal-operation review (MUTCD §6N.12, 11th Ed. p. 848; Part 4 for signal-head visibility) remain with the traffic control supervisor. Intersection support is tracked at issue #117; corner-quadrant work at issue #128.
Drawn as 4 lanes per direction; the road has 5. Plans draw at most 4 lanes per direction, so the device offsets are measured against 4 lanes.
